title: Google and Microsoft sign-in
summary: Add optional Google and Microsoft OAuth entry points without changing roster authorization.
changes: Approved roster members can start sign-in with Google or Microsoft from the existing account screen.
OAuth sessions return to the existing Night Roster URL and still have to pass the allowed-users and RLS authorization checks.
Microsoft requests only the email scope required for roster access, while OAuth client secrets stay in Supabase and never enter the public GitHub repository.
Email/password, password reset and passkey sign-in remain available, with roster calculations and staffing behaviour unchanged.
